text:
Priya R (Partnerships): Hey all, merchant partner sent over an enterprise questionnaire and wants a shared POC architecture. Copilot-style convo.
Sam S (Sales): quick ask — can we give them a sandbox with SSO + isolated VPC? They're asking for egress IPs and audit logs.
Marcus T (Solutions): Yes — we can spin a Dedicated pool in their ACCT with a private endpoint. Need to confirm networking egress behavior and cost.
Jenna (Security): Qs from security: 1) Are tokens stored customer-side? 2) KMS integration? 3) Session audit retention window.
Alex P (Product): Tokens are not stored server-side by default; we offer KMS integration for Private deployments. Audit retention configurable via Console.
Sam S (Sales): Pricing question: partner wants committed months + overage. Also curious about per-hour reserved GPU vs. burst pricing for the POC.
Marcus T (Solutions): For a 30-day POC we usually recommend a small dedicated pool + burst. Estimate: baseline commit = 2 A100-h equivalent -> ¬ $Xk/mo, burst billed at on-demand rate.
Priya R (Partnerships): They'd like a runbook for day-1 onboarding and a simple checklist for SSO + IP allowlist. Can we draft one?
Marcus T (Solutions): I'll put together a 1-pager. Draft checklist: 1) SSO SAML metadata exchange 2) VPC peering / private endpoint 3) egress NAT IPs 4) KMS config 5) seed model/version
Jenna (Security): Also add: data retention SLA, breach notification contact, and DH key lifecycle notes.
Alex P (Product): Note: model pinning required for reproducible evals. Recommend pin to v1.2.quant for the POC to match performance profile.
Sam S (Sales): Partner also asked for sample responses to their security questionnaire. Can someone run through the SOC/ISO blurbs?
Jenna (Security): I'll attach standard paragraphs. For now: "Redwood supports role-based access, KMS-managed keys, and detailed audit logs. We can sign an NDA and process DPA." :shield:
Priya R (Partnerships): Would love a short timeline for setup — can we do 72h from signed SOW if infra is green?
Marcus T (Solutions): Realistic: 3 business days for infra + SSO config, + partner side idp changes. 72h is doable assuming no blocker.
deploy-bot: Deployment triggered by @Marcus T — provisioning dedicated pool (req-id: req-1987). Status: queued.
Priya R (Partnerships): Great. Marcus, can you include estimated monthly commit and a best/worst-case for overage in the 1-pager?
Marcus T (Solutions): Yep. I'll drop the draft here by EOD. Also including sample egress IP list and the minimal firewall rules (example below).
Marcus T (Solutions): ```
# minimal egress rules for partner firewall
allow tcp 443 to 35.227.10.0/24 # control plane
allow tcp 443 to 104.248.200.0/22 # model endpoints
``` 
Sam S (Sales): Thanks — that helps. Priya, can you confirm whether partner needs a co-sell contract or reseller? their legal back-and-forth might add 2 weeks.
Priya R (Partnerships): I'll check and loop legal if needed. tagging @Jenna for any compliance red flags.
Jenna (Security): No red flags so far, just ensure DPA and KMS flow are documented.
Priya R (Partnerships): Awesome. We'll reconvene after Marcus posts the runbook. :thumbsup:
Marcus T (Solutions): Draft incoming. —end
